title: Separate a refused renewal from an unconfirmed one in the companion
goal: A renewal refused before any request names the reason and says the pairing is unchanged; only unknown outcomes say not confirmed
acceptance: A committed Swift test fails before the fix for a renewal refused on the Mac
Unknown outcomes (no reply, Keychain save failure after a reply) keep the unconfirmed message
escalation: Any change to what is sent during renewal goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-12: split the catch in pair() by phase, two texts, one Swift test. Not a measurement.
